app.name: PoxiISO
usb.title: Choose your USB
usb.subtitle: Plug in a flash drive and select it. The list refreshes on its own.
usb.empty: No USB detected. Plug one in and wait a second.
confirm.title: Review before starting
confirm.warn: ALL content on {name} ({size}) will be erased. This cannot be undone.
confirm.warnUpdate: PoxiISO will be updated on {name} ({size}). Your ISOs and files are kept.
adv.title: Advanced options
progress.title: Installing…
progress.hint: Do not remove the USB until it finishes.
err.title: Something went wrong
err.INSTALL_FAILED: Installation failed. Make sure the USB is not write-protected and try again.
err.TIMEOUT: It took too long. Did you remove the USB? Plug it back in and try again.
err.generic: The operation could not be completed.
about.text: PoxiISO is based on Ventoy (GPLv3). All credit for the boot engine goes to the original project.
done.noTheme: The USB is ready, but the boot menu theme could not be applied. It will work with the basic Ventoy look.
isos.title: ISOs
isos.sub: Copy ISOs to your USB or download them here. PoxiISO lists them in the boot menu.
isos.noUsbText: Install it from the Install tab and come back.
isos.dropHint: or pick them from the file explorer (several at once)
isos.empty: There are no ISOs on this USB yet.
isos.tooBig: {n} do not fit on a FAT32 USB (4 GB per file maximum). Reinstall PoxiISO with exFAT or NTFS under Advanced options.
isos.nothing: Nothing valid to copy. Supports .iso, .wim, .img, .vhd, .vhdx and .efi.
err.NO_SPACE: There is not enough space on the USB for that.
err.CANCELLED: Copy cancelled. No half-written file was left behind.
err.NOT_ALLOWED: That USB is no longer available. Pick it again.
err.COPY_FAILED: Could not copy. Check that the USB is still plugged in.
dl.pasteHint: https://… (.iso, .img, .wim…) or a Google Drive link
dl.toUsb: It will download to your PC, be verified and copied to {usb}. The temporary copy is then deleted.
dl.toPc: No USB with PoxiISO: it will be saved in {dir}.
dl.resume: Press Download to continue where it stopped.
dl.kept: the ISO was kept on your PC ({file})
dl.doneNoVerify: Downloaded: {name} (this source publishes no checksum to verify it).
err.HTTP_ERROR: The server did not deliver the file (the link may have changed).
err.HTML_RESPONSE: Google Drive is not allowing the download right now (usually the daily quota). Try later.
err.SHA_MISMATCH: The file does not match its official checksum and was discarded. Try again.
err.BAD_URL: That link is not valid: it must start with https://
err.NO_MATCH: Could not find the latest version on the official server.
err.SUMS_FAILED: Could not check the official checksum; for safety nothing is downloaded.
err.DL_FAILED: The download could not be completed.
set.title: Settings
set.langHint: Language of this app, the advanced menu configurator and the boot menu (applied when installing).
set.parts: {n} unfinished file(s) · {size}. They resume if you download the same ISO again.
adv.hint: Only if you know what you are doing. The defaults work on almost every PC.
adv.gptHint: Recommended: PCs from the last 10 years (UEFI)
adv.fat32Hint: Very compatible, but 4 GB per file max
done.next: USB ready! Now add systems: drop your ISOs here or download them.
boot.title: Boot menu
boot.sub: Customize the menu shown when booting from the USB: names, icons, passwords, automatic installs… The configurator opens in your browser.
boot.runningText: It is in your browser. Changes are saved to the USB automatically; close it here when you are done.
err.NO_DIALOG: The configurator could not be opened. If another one is open, close it and try again.
err.NO_DISK: The configurator cannot find that USB. Unplug it, plug it back in and try again.
err.NO_SERVER: The configurator did not start. Please try again.
dl.search: Search a system: Zorin, Mint, Fedora, Hiren’s…
dl.noResults: Nothing matches “{q}”. Try another word or paste the ISO link above.
boot.pvCard: See how the menu will look when you start a PC from this USB, with your ISOs and their icons.
boot.pvLink: See how it looks at boot
boot.pvSample: Example: this is how it would look with some ISOs (your USB has none yet).
boot.pvHint: ↑ ↓ or mouse wheel to move · Enter to “boot” · Esc to close
boot.pvEnter: On the PC, it would now boot “{name}”.
boot.pvHotkeys: L:Language  F1:Help  F2:Browse  F3:TreeView  F4:Localboot  F5:Tools  F6:ExMenu
